     * chrome; only the reading surface between them is light.·

     * Every colour here is a `--kb-*` token scoped to `.vx-kb-page`, with no·

     * turns these pages dark. The global site tokens (--bg, --panel, --text-*)·

     * widget render exactly as on every other page.·

    .vx-kb-page {·
